next-meeting.name: Next meeting
next-meeting.description: Your next meeting from your calendar, with a Join button. It shows on the notch 5 minutes before it starts.
next-meeting.urlHint: The private iCal or .ics link from Google Calendar, Outlook or iCloud. Atap keeps it locked on this PC and never shows it again.
next-meeting.privacy: Atap downloads your calendar from the link you give it, every 15 minutes. The calendar stays in memory and is never saved on your PC.
next-meeting.noLink: Add your calendar link in this widget's settings.
next-meeting.failed: Could not load your calendar. Check the link and your connection.
